newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 20 bln levs 5-yr floater T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 20 bln levs 5-yr floater T-bonds.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer 20 billion levs of five-year, floating interest T-bonds with no minimum acceptable price set in advance at an auction today, the central bank said.
Interest on the paper is set at four percentage points over the central bank annual main interest rate for the period to maturity and would be adjusted each time the main rate changes.
The central bank on Thursday cut the main rate to 4.29 percent monthly or 51.48 annually from 5.2 percent monthly or 62.40 annually, to go in force from Monday, May 19.
Coupon payments are due semi-annually until maturity. Principal is due at maturity together with the last coupon payment.
